index.html.title: Real Estate Tax Planning & Cost Segregation | AE Tax
index.html.description: Review rental tax planning, cost segregation study scope and fees. Prepare property records and discuss your real estate portfolio with AE Tax Advisors.
index.html.heading: Match the review to your property decision
index.html.body:
Choose real estate tax planning for a portfolio review or cost segregation study services for a property-specific scope. Compare study pricing and included work before ordering a report.

Bring acquisition dates, closing records, improvement costs and existing depreciation schedules. Discuss your property and planning priorities; confirm study delivery and return implementation responsibilities separately.
